purpose: Resolve the finite-query coverage floor on higher-dimensional E3 manifolds and compare Single with Multi for STSP, DR, and YY

adaptive_rule.description: Run stage 1 first. Stage 2 is mandatory only for method/geometry pairs that do not meet the frozen separation rule at stage 1.
adaptive_rule.separation_rule: There must be at least three consecutive scales at which Single and Multi are both reliable, their ordering is identical across the interval, and delta_query is at most one half of the median absolute Single-Multi E_rev gap on that interval.

execution.DR_YY: Reuse the audited 1024-query packets and evaluate only the complementary points needed by the current stage.
execution.STSP: No reusable per-query E3 packet exists. Stage 1 recomputes the frozen repeat-0 observation and full stage-1 query grid; stage 2 evaluates only the complementary points.
execution.gpu_policy: DR and YY start only after the E7 DR/YY production run releases its assigned GPU; do not interfere with other GPU tasks.
execution.cpu_policy: STSP starts only after an isolated benchmark confirms that its CPU allocation does not slow active formal GPU jobs.
